# Test Before You Build

> Customer validation through 20 interviews with realistic potential customers before a major development investment.

Test Before You Build helps founders, companies, and research teams examine whether a product, service, software concept, or research-based innovation addresses a commercially meaningful customer problem. The fixed-price Idea Validation Sprint costs €2,900 + VAT and ends with a BUILD, CHANGE, or KILL recommendation.

Service provider: Dr. Kari Jääskeläinen, entrepreneur, business leader, and customer validation consultant with experience from around 200 commercialization and business development projects.

- [How to validate a business idea before you build](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-validate-a-business-idea/): Practical guide to assumptions, customer evidence, validation methods and BUILD, CHANGE or KILL decisions.
- [Business idea validation guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-to-validate-a-business-idea/index.md): Text equivalent of the business idea validation guide.
- [Market validation: process, methods and examples](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/market-validation/): Guide to market validation definitions, method selection, evidence quality and decision-making.
- [Market validation guide in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/market-validation/index.md): Text equivalent of the market validation guide.
- [How many customer interviews are enough?](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/how-many-customer-interviews/): Evidence-based guide to interview sample size, information sufficiency and project scoping.

- [About Dr. Kari Jääskeläinen](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/about-kari-jaaskelainen/): Professional background, selected experience and relevance to independent market validation.
- [About Dr. Kari Jääskeläinen in Markdown](https://testbeforeyoubuild.com/about-kari-jaaskelainen.md): Text equivalent of the profile page.
